review_evidence: README identifies a native Lean implementation of several cryptographic functions rather than foreign-library bindings.

The elliptic-curve module defines well-formedness as a proposition, curve points and on-curve predicates, point arithmetic, scalar multiplication, groups, and key-pair structures; other modules encode hashes, fields, and cryptographic algorithms.
These executable mathematical/specification definitions are unique formal prior art even where theorem coverage is incomplete, so no lossless source-local exclusion was identified.
summary: Retain crypto-lean4 as native Lean cryptographic specification and implementation material, including elliptic-curve predicates and algorithms.
